desc: Ideation complete: only negative values can improve the answer, and the best array after deleting a value can be obtained by concatenating the non-x blocks.
Implement the segment-tree monoid (sum, pref, suff, best), identity, combine, and range query.
Precompute prefix and suffix block summaries to answer first/last blocks in O(1) and reduce segment-tree queries to middle blocks.
Group indices by value, skip non-negative values and values whose removal empties the array, and combine non-empty blocks for each remaining value.
Handle edge cases: all elements equal, adjacent occurrences/empty blocks, all-negative arrays, single element, and the option of no deletion.
Validate with the provided examples and a small random brute-force checker; sample, random, and exhaustive checks pass.
